title: C: Binary Search
description: Implement binary search to find a target value in a sorted integer array.

steps.title: Iterative Binary Search
steps.description: Write a function `int binary_search(int arr[], int n, int target)` that returns the index of the target or -1 if not found. Test with `{2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38, 56, 72, 91}` searching for 23.
hints: While left <= right, check the middle element.
If arr[mid] < target, search right half; else search left half.

verification.failureMessage: Find index of 23 and print it (should be 5)
